newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish firm says employee kidnapped in Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Swedish firm says employee kidnapped in Colombia.

text.p: A Norwegian employee of Swedish construction group Skanska AB has been reported kidnapped in Colombia while on vacation, a company spokesman said on Monday.
Forty-six-year-old foreman Stein Vatne works at Skanska's hydroelectric power project Urra in Colombia.
Vatne left Urra by plane on February 20 and was reported to have continued from Monteria by car on his way to see his family in Ecuador.
The company called the police after he failed to contact his office by the end of February.
Military personnel found his car abandoned with a broken ignition switch 100 km (65 miles) north of Medellin.
Vatne has lived in Latin America since 1986, and speaks Spanish.
Two engineers working for Skanska were kidnapped in December 1994 on their way to work. They were both released unharmed after six months.
